content.text:
شَرْط

---

*condition*
*stipulation*
*prerequisite*

---

ش - ر - ط

the root cuts through:
**شَرَطَ** — to make an incision, to stipulate, to condition

---

شُرْطة — police (those who mark/enforce)
شَريط — tape, ribbon (that which binds along a line)
مَشْروط — conditional
اشْتِراط — requirement

---

the blade that marks the line
between *if* and *then*

بِشَرْطِ أَنْ — on the condition that

---

every contract has teeth
every promise, a cut
